links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of AI-generated PAD patient education responses
links.effect: Mean FK grade ChatGPT 10.81, Gemini 10.73; both higher than the recommended reading level for patient education.
links.quote: FK analysis showed no significant readability differences between the two chatbots (mean FK grade: ChatGPT, 10.81; Gemini, 10.73), although both were higher than the recommended reading level for patient education.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Mean FK grade 10.81 (ChatGPT) and 10.73 (Gemini), exceeding national guideline reading levels.
links.quote: However, the grade reading level of these materials exceeded the recommended reading levels set forth by national guidelines, which warrants improvement in AI-driven health communication.

screen.reason: The study tests the impact of different prompt specifications (no prompt, patient-level, physician-level) on LLM accuracy and readability for patient education questions.
